tasks.name: Asymmetric-tin-BC Luikov inverse with corrected geometry
tasks.deliverable: src/data/spatial_reconstruction/luikov_tin.py: Luikov 1D coupled heat-mass on full-thickness domain x in [0, L]; radiative-convective BC at top (x=0) and conductive-tin BC at bottom (x=L); real probe geometry with sensor depths d_i = D - (i-1) × 13.6mm. fit_luikov_tin_inverse: 8-param Nelder-Mead fit (L, D, Lu, Ko, Bi_top, Bi_bottom, T_oven_eff, T_tin_eff) with Hessian-based correlation matrix. tests/test_luikov_tin_research.py: forward sanity (BC-asymmetry checks), synthetic recovery, real-CSV viability sweep, LOO subset on 3 representative fixtures with focus on T1 and T2 held-out. tests/_driver_luikov_tin.py: end-to-end driver. tests/baselines/luikov_tin_research.md: report with comparison vs M9/M14/M13 LOO baseline. NOT wired into runtime classifier.
tasks.validation_required: Forward sanity passes both top-only-heated and bottom-only-heated symmetry-breaking checks. Synthetic recovery with DIFFERENT-class generator passes within 30 percent on at least 1 case. Real-CSV joint inverse converges on at least 5 of 7 fixtures, with at least 6 of 8 parameters NOT hitting bounds. LOO subset includes T1 and T2 held-out RMSE per fixture. Existing M1-M14 tests untouched.
